attackDamage.description: The damage that character's attack power and ultimate weapons can cause to enemies.

attackSpeed.description: Speed projectiles are fired from player

bounceChance.description: Probability of projectile bouncing to another enemy after hitting one

bounceCount.description: Number of times a projectile can bounce from enemy to enemy

criticalChance.description: Chance of each projectile to deal critical damage

damagePerRange.description: Damage increased the further the enemy is from the player

multiShootChance.description: Chance to shoot more than one projectile when firing

multiShootCount.description: Number of projetiles shot when multishot activates

stuntChance.description: Probability of triggering stunt effect when attacking

stuntDuration.description: Can stunt enemies for a period of time

ultimateAttack.description: Extra Attack Power from Ultimate Weapon

manaPoint.description: Maximum mana pool. Ultimates and mana-cost skills draw from this

healthRegen.description: Amount of player health regenerated per second

deathDefy.description: When suffering fatal damage, there's a chance to retain 5% max health

defenseAmount.description: Reduced absolute damage when player attacked

evasion.description: An opportunity to avoid direct enemy attacks

hitRate.description: Base chance to land a hit. Enemy evasion subtracts from this: HitChance = HitRate - TargetEvasion

lifeSteal.description: Can heal health player, percentage amount from attack damage player to enemies

interestWave.description: Earn a percent of gold and meat kept on hand at the end of wave
